name: CupertinoPageRoute
description: An iOS-style page route that transitions between screens with a Cupertino (iOS) page animation. It provides a swipe-back gesture to pop the current route and uses the standard iOS navigation transition.

properties.name: builder
properties.description: The builder function to create the primary contents of the route.

properties.name: settings
properties.description: Configuration information for the route, such as name and arguments.

properties.name: fullscreenDialog
properties.description: Whether the page is displayed as a full-screen modal dialog.

properties.name: maintainState
properties.description: Whether the route should remain in memory when it is inactive.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The title of the route, used by iOS for the back button text of the previous page.

properties.name: allowSnapshotting
properties.description: Determines whether this route can be snapshotted for use in iOS transition animations.
